title: 第19章 江云风中毒第20章 血火佣兵团据点
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
江尘打算回家里，突然，看到前方出现了骚动。
“不好了，我们的货物被血火佣兵团给劫了，不少人都受伤了，还死了不少人。”
就在这时，传出了惊慌的声音。
很多江家的人闻言都大惊失色。
护送货物有很多江家的人啊，江尘闻言，也是面色微变，他记得父亲江云风也是负责运送货物的。
江尘快步上前，结果看到很多人被抬着回来的，他还看了自己的父亲江云风也是被人抬着回来的。
“爹。”
江尘连忙上前，但是江云风陷入昏迷中，根本没有半点反应。
如果不是他还有气息，还以为他死了。
“我爹怎么了？”
江尘连忙问身边的人。
“七长老他为了保住货物，跟血火佣兵团的人大战，结果我们江家的人根本就不是对手，货物被血火佣兵团抢了去，死了一些人，七长老也是中了毒，昏迷不醒。”
一名江家的护卫道。
他们这一行人有三十多人的，死了十三个人，其他人身上都有不同程度的伤势。
血火佣兵团抢到东西之后，也没有赶尽杀绝，担心对方反扑，会造成给佣兵团造成更大的伤亡。
要求江家的人将财物交出来，血火佣兵团不为难。
其他江家人为了活命，于是将货物，还有身上的储物袋都交出去，只留下武器。
血火佣兵团本来就是求财的，得到想要的东西了，也没有必要跟江家的人拼死拼命。
“什么？”
江尘面色大变。

如果江云风出了什么事，那怎么办？
很快，众人就将江云风给带到家里，江家人都震动了。
江家族长江天也是知晓了货物被劫的消息，也是面色大变。
还有江云风中毒，生命垂危，这是震惊江家的大事。
江家会送一批货物到云罗城卖掉，然后再进一批货物回到青月镇出售。
这一次货被血火佣兵团给劫了，他们都尽量地避开血火佣兵团的势力范围了，这一次只能说运气不好。
“王大师，他的情况怎么样？”
江天向眼前的炼丹师询问道。
这个王大师是二阶炼丹师，在青月镇是一个比较有名气的医师。
“哎，这个毒相当棘手，我也不知道是什么毒，我能力有限，无能为力了，你们要有心理准备。”
王大师叹气道。
他只是一个二阶炼丹师，这种毒他区分不出来。
“怎么会这样！”
江天后退数步。
江云风是他的小儿子，江云风出事了，他也非常担忧的。
江尘也是面色一白，接着就是愤怒。
血火佣兵团，这一次真是将江尘给惹怒了。
李慧容听到王大师的话，也是泣不成声。
content_en:
Jiang Chen was about to go home, but suddenly, he saw a commotion ahead.
"No, our goods were robbed by the Bloodfire Mercenary Group. Many people were injured and many died."
At this moment, panicked sounds came out.
Many people in the Jiang family were shocked when they heard this.
There were many people from the Jiang family escorting the goods. When Jiang Chen heard this, his expression changed slightly. He remembered that his father Jiang Yunfeng was also responsible for transporting the goods.
Jiang Chen stepped forward quickly and saw many people being carried back. He also saw that his father, Jiang Yunfeng, was also being carried back.
"Dad."
Jiang Chen stepped forward quickly, but Jiang Yunfeng fell into a coma and did not react at all.
If he wasn't still breathing, I would have thought he was dead.
"What happened to my dad?"
Jiang Chen quickly asked the people around him.
"In order to save the goods, the Seventh Elder fought with the people of the Blood and Fire Mercenary Group. As a result, our Jiang family members were no match at all. The goods were snatched away by the Blood and Fire Mercenary Group, and some people died. The Seventh Elder was also poisoned and fell into a coma."
A Jiang family guard said.
There were more than thirty people in their group, thirteen people died, and the others suffered varying degrees of injuries.
After the Blood Fire Mercenary Group grabbed the items, they did not kill them all. They were worried that the other party's counterattack would cause greater casualties to the mercenary group.
The Blood and Fire Mercenary Group was not embarrassed when they asked the Jiang family to hand over their belongings.
In order to survive, the other Jiang family members handed over their goods and storage bags, leaving only their weapons.
The Blood and Fire Mercenary Group was originally looking for money. Once they got what they wanted, there was no need to fight to the death with the Jiang family.
"What?"
Jiang Chen's expression changed drastically.
What if something happens to Jiang Yunfeng?
Soon, everyone brought Jiang Yunfeng home, and the Jiang family was shocked.
Jiang Tian, ​​the head of the Jiang family, also learned about the robbery of the goods, and his expression changed drastically.
Jiang Yunfeng was also poisoned and his life was in danger. This was a major event that shocked the Jiang family.
The Jiang family will send a batch of goods to Yunluo City to sell, and then bring another batch of goods back to Qingyue Town for sale.
This time the goods were robbed by the Blood Fire Mercenary Group. They all tried their best to avoid the Blood Fire Mercenary Group's sphere of influence. This time it can only be said that they were unlucky.
"Master Wang, how is his condition?"
Jiang Tian asked the alchemist in front of him.
This Master Wang is a second-level alchemist and a relatively famous doctor in Qingyue Town.
"Hey, this poison is quite tricky. I don't know what it is. My abilities are limited and I can't do anything about it. You must be mentally prepared."
Master Wang sighed.
He was just a second-level alchemist, and he couldn't tell the difference between this kind of poison.
"How could this happen!"
Jiang Tian took a few steps back.
Jiang Yunfeng was his youngest son. If something happened to Jiang Yunfeng, he would be very worried.
Jiang Chen also turned pale, and then became angry.
The Blood Fire Mercenary Group really made Jiang Chen angry this time.
Li Huirong burst into tears when she heard Master Wang's words.
